pendingNotices.title: False Orders
pendingNotices.details: The Rebel player played False Orders at the end of the Assignment phase. It targets a leader who is alone on a mission: Emperor Palpatine returns to your leader pool, and that mission card goes back to your hand unrevealed. You can use Emperor Palpatine again this round to oppose missions, activate a system, or move.
